automated_certification.note: P6 release-gate infrastructure source/CI baseline. Full correction CI, P4 UAT and P5 business E2E suites passed. Evidence-only commits after this baseline do not authorize production.

manual_gates.note: No connected host-level backup/staging capability. Require full database + plugin/files backup, independent protected eh7_document_key backup, and proved restore on controlled staging.
WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE and DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT are not explicitly defined. Apply only after backup/restore proof and according to actual staging/production role.
Need dedicated UAT identity over real HTTPS: login, Bearer GET, refresh rotation, invalid/expired 401, insufficient-scope 403, logout/revocation.
Need physical Android device pilot on a controlled staging API: install, login, permission states, check-in, GPS points, resume, checkout/auto-stop.
Need controlled staging multipart HR upload, authenticated download/hash check, deactivation/revocation, and recovery with matching document key.
Business owner/Accounts must reconcile Sales, Purchase, Stock, Trial Balance, P&L, Balance Sheet, AR and AP against controlled staging transactions.
Operational owner plus HR and Accounts sign-off required. CI evidence does not replace human acceptance.
